method: Two isolated Runtime crate copies from the same current tree. Baseline replaces only changed request-builder, author argument gate, Tutor schema examples and learner view with pre-change functions. Concurrent agent.progress changes are identical in both arms. Same new scenario fixture runs in both. Main worktree not swapped.

live_delivery.common_changes: Both arms use identical server code, test-only stream entry, existing shared agent.progress dispatch fixes and static fixture content. Relative include paths only are adjusted for isolated crate compilation.
live_delivery.provider: Configured NativeAdapter; normal runtime profile/reasoning/tool selection. No scripted model, review or tool result.
live_delivery.scenario: One real temporary source book, active Tutor, two consecutive text explanations; actual first delivered turn persisted and passed into the second.
live_delivery.warmup: live-delivery-candidate: 19 HTTP requests, two successful deliveries. Overlapped baseline compilation; retained for quality and cost, excluded from latency comparison.
live_delivery.limits: 24 actual HTTP attempts per run including retries and private model calls; no budget extension. Sequential comparison runs without local compilation.
live_delivery.timestamp: Each actual HTTP start has UTC Unix milliseconds for rate selection.

q1.cache_isolation: baseline-q1 and candidate-q1 share Q1 guidance and review rules; only cache implementation differs. Sixteen bounded real Native calls, same recorded histories.
q1.fixed_replay_environment: Local follow-up test compilation overlapped; timings retained but not used for speed attribution.
q1.delivery_comparison: Original baseline vs final Q1 cache + immutable-fact preflight + quality guidance; reused baseline costs are not counted twice.
q1.delivery_environment: Our compilation and fixed replay finished before real delivery started. Other tasks had cargo/rustc activity on this machine at start; see live-delivery-candidate-q1-environment.json. Latency is descriptive, not isolated causal evidence.
